<user_query>
You are performing automated UI/UX sign-off for PRD-D (平板 SmartCalendar toggle 文字溢出修正). The frontend has been deployed to http://localhost.

Goals:
1. Navigate to http://localhost in browser.
2. If a login page appears, use these credentials to log in:
   - LoginName: admin
   - Password: admin (try first)
   If admin/admin fails, try: LoginName: super / Password: super. If still fails, try another common test credential like director/director. If all login attempts fail, capture a snapshot of the login screen and report blocker.
3. After successful login, navigate to the SmartCalendar page. The route is typically /smart-calendar or accessible via the left sidebar "行事曆/課表" link.
4. Switch to "日檢視" view if not already (the toolbar toggle button pair "日檢視 / 週檢視").
5. Use browser_resize to test at these viewport widths in sequence: 768x1024 (iPad portrait), 900x1200, 1024x1366 (iPad landscape), 1280x800 (desktop baseline).
6. For EACH viewport width:
   a. Take a viewport screenshot and save to /home/admin/backend/storage/screenshots/prd-d-smartcal-{width}px.png (use browser_take_screenshot with a filename hint).
   b. Use browser_snapshot to find the element with text "只顯示今日有課老師" (the toggle label).
   c. Use browser_get_bounding_box to measure the toggle container's rendered rect. Verify:
      - At 768/900/1024px: toggle height ≥ 44px (WCAG touch target) and the "只顯示今日有課老師" text is NOT clipped (text content width fits within toggle bounding box).
      - At 1280px: toggle should still render inline at ~38px height with text on a single line (no regression).
   d. Hover the toggle and confirm no visual glitch. Click the checkbox; verify it toggles the "hideEmptyTeacherColumns" state (the teacher columns should change — but do not worry about data details, just verify click works without JS error; use browser_console_messages to check for errors).

Report back:
- Which viewport widths passed (list each).
- Screenshot file paths created.
- Toggle bounding box dimensions observed at each viewport (width x height, and text-content width).
- Any console errors encountered.
- Final verdict: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL.

If you can't reach the app at http://localhost (for any reason such as credentials failure, app not loading, route not found), please report this clearly and stop after 3-4 attempts rather than looping. Do NOT try to fix issues, only verify and report.
</user_query>
